import { TABLES, find, update } from '@/lib/store';
import { ApiError, errorResponse } from '@/lib/errors';

export async function POST(request: Request, { params }: { params: { run_id: string } }) {
  try {
    let body: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      body = await request.json();
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError('validation_error', 'Request body must be valid JSON');
    }

    const name = body.name;
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || name.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new ApiError('validation_error', 'Participant name is required');
    }

    const trimmedName = name.trim();

    const run = find(TABLES.Run, params.run_id);
    if (!run) {
      throw new ApiError('run_not_found', `Run '${params.run_id}' was not found`);
    }

    const participants: string[] = (run.participants as string[]) || [];
    const isDuplicate = participants.some(
      (p) => p.toLowerCase() === trimmedName.toLowerCase()
    );

    if (isDuplicate) {
      throw new ApiError('duplicate_participant', `Participant '${trimmedName}' is already registered for this run`);
    }

    run.participants = [...participants, trimmedName];
    const updatedRun = update(TABLES.Run, run);
    return Response.json(updatedRun);
  } catch (err) {
    return errorResponse(err);
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: Request, { params }: { params: { run_id: string } }) {
  try {
    let name: string | undefined;

    const url = new URL(request.url);
    name = url.searchParams.get('name') || undefined;

    if (!name) {
      try {
        const body: Record<string, unknown> = await request.json();
        if (typeof body.name === 'string') {
          name = body.name;
        }
      } catch {
        // no JSON body
      }
    }

    if (!name || name.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new ApiError('validation_error', 'Participant name is required');
    }

    const trimmedName = name.trim();

    const run = find(TABLES.Run, params.run_id);
    if (!run) {
      throw new ApiError('run_not_found', `Run '${params.run_id}' was not found`);
    }

    const participants: string[] = (run.participants as string[]) || [];
    const index = participants.findIndex(
      (p) => p.toLowerCase() === trimmedName.toLowerCase()
    );

    if (index === -1) {
      throw new ApiError('participant_not_found', `Participant '${trimmedName}' was not found on this run`);
    }

    run.participants = participants.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    const updatedRun = update(TABLES.Run, run);
    return Response.json(updatedRun);
  } catch (err) {
    return errorResponse(err);
  }
}
